headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.8 for longer agentic tasks
body: A light day. Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, built for longer agentic coding tasks, adding a little to both Capability Velocity and AI Autonomy. That lifts endings with capable, independent AI, including Descendants, Protector God and Zookeeper. South Korea launched a plan against AI-enabled cyberattacks. Horizon Balance is 0.9, up 0.04.
movers_note: Descendants +0.1, from the Claude Opus 4.8 launch (+0.18), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.05). Protector God +0.1, from the Claude Opus 4.8 launch (+0.15), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.03). Reversion -0.1, mostly from the Claude Opus 4.8 launch (-0.12) and South Korea's cyber plan (-0.02).
